QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] A Bridge Between Worlds
QuestInfo.0: #p9400222# seems asks how you keep losing your color. Should you tell them the truth?
QuestInfo.1: You told #p9400222# the truth about the Land of Contemplation. Enthralled by the thought of a world ripe for the coloring, #p9400222# agrees to tag along. #p9400222# agreed to paint a bridge to that world, but you'll need to collect more color.\r\nThere's still paint left over from before, so filling the bucket shouldn't be too hard.
QuestInfo.2: At your request, #p9400222# painted a bridge to the Land of Contemplation.\r\nWill #p9400222# be happy living here?
